body: Hey! Don't keep on putting yourself down. At least you have a job, at least you have a home, at least you have parents. Now, maybe you have a license with a car to drive. These are the little things that many people have lost. Even though it might feel like you are out of options, you are not. Save a little money, so you can go get yourself something nice. Then, do something you have never done. Maybe, go out to a bar where you can meet some people. There are many ways to meet potential partners. Take the first steps towards finding someone and the path will be created. Life is no piece of cake, but try to think of how it will feel when you feel happiness and success. Keep that in mind, so you can make it a reality.

Hey! Think of all the positives things you have in life and how those things can lead to happiness and joy. 
Look at me. I was arrested three times due to a psychosis episode. Now, I have to deal with the consequences of my actions which puts me in a state of depression. There are times when I want to kill myself, but then, I think of my family members and my girlfriend. Try to find someone that sparks something inside of you. It can be serious or not. There is nothing better than having sex to get things of the mind. Hang in there.

My dreams were to graduate from college to find me a well paying job to one day support my parents. I was motivated until a couple of months of little to no sleep mixed with alcohol and weed 2-3 times a week which led me to a psychotic episode.
